name: Moon
note: Gravity: NASA Planetary Fact Sheet. No atmosphere. Pure powered descent required.

name: Mars
note: Gravity: NASA Planetary Fact Sheet. Very thin CO2 atmosphere — parachute helps but powered descent still needed.

name: Titan
note: Gravity: NASA Planetary Fact Sheet. Thick nitrogen atmosphere — parachute very effective. Low solar flux: RTG recommended.

name: Venus
note: Gravity: NASA Planetary Fact Sheet. Extremely thick and hot CO2 atmosphere. Very short surface lifetime — heat shield critical.

name: Ryugu-class Asteroid
note: Gravity: game value representative of small C-type asteroid. Escape risk: very gentle touchdown required.
